Our process

The FlowMelon way. A clear path from idea to launch

A streamlined, step-by-step system. From planning to deployment, every stage is built to ensure performance, flexibility and scalability for your business.

1

Kickoff Call & Requirement Gathering

We start by understanding your business goals, user needs and technical requirements to shape a clear development roadmap.

2

Architecture Planning & Tech Stack

We plan the CMS structure, class system and integrations that match your scalability, performance and security goals.

3

Frontend Development

We turn designs into responsive, user-friendly interfaces with clean, modern code that works smoothly on every device.

4

CMS & Integrations

Collections, forms, HubSpot, Zapier and APIs — the core functionality wired up so the foundation is solid and secure.

5

QA & Bug Fixing

Thorough testing across browsers and devices to catch bugs, ensure compatibility and optimize loading speed.

6

Launch & Ongoing Support

We handle deployment, monitor performance and provide continuous support to keep your site running and growing.
